queries_run: AMKR Amkor Technology antitrust OR DOJ OR FTC OR EU competition investigation 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 的政府法規章節指出，法規遵循成本目前對資本支出、營運結果與競爭地位不重大，且預期無重大合規支出；搜尋未發現 2026 年反壟斷調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1 Governmental Regulations
findings.excerpt: Costs and accruals incurred to comply with these governmental regulations are presently not material to our capital expenditures, results of operations and competitive position.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素列出出口管制（BIS 規則）限制對部分中國公司銷售，屬產業特定貿易監管。
findings.excerpt: These expanded export restrictions limit our ability to sell to certain Chinese companies and to third parties that do business with those companies.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋無 DOJ/FTC/EU 對 AMKR 的反壟斷調查來源。
